nodes.name: T6 heat treatment of 7075 Al alloy
nodes.procedure: The 7075 Al alloy was subjected to T6 heat treatment: solution treating at 480 °C for 2 h followed by rapid quenching in water and finally age hardening at 120 °C for 24 h. The chemical composition was examined by X-ray fluorescence spectroscopy.
nodes.source_text: T6 heat treatment involves solution treating at 480 °C for 2 h followed by rapid quenching in water and finally age hardening at 120 °C for 24 h. The chemical composition of the alloy is examined by X-ray fluorescence spectroscopy

nodes.name: 3 passes USRP treatment
nodes.procedure: Cylindrical samples of 7075-T6 Al alloy (120 mm in length and 26 mm in diameter) were subjected to 3 passes of ultrasonic surface rolling process (USRP). The specific USRP processing parameter values, including the current, pressure, feed rate, and lathe spindle speed, are shown in the inset table in Fig. 1. After USRP, each sample was immediately immersed in acetone to remove lubricating oil from its surface. The samples were then air-cooled and dried for later use.

nodes.characterization_summary: Cross-sectional OM shows untreated CG sample average grain size of 4 μm; USRP-treated samples show gradient deformation layers of depths 208 μm (3 passes), 332 μm (7 passes), 350 μm (12 passes).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 2(a) displays the microstructure of a sample before USRP (denoted CG sample) with an average grain size of 4 μm. ... the depths of the gradient deformation layers in the samples with 3, 7, and 12 USRP treatment passes were 208 μm, 332 μm, and 350 μm, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM observes surface morphologies and corrosion morphologies after immersion testing, showing reduced corrosion pits in USRP-treated samples.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The surface morphologies of the samples were observed by scanning electron microscopy (SEM, ZEISS SUPRA55).

nodes.characterization_summary: Surface roughness dramatically reduced after USRP: Ra and Rz values 92% and 89% lower for 3-passes-DG, 84% and 81% lower for 7-passes-NG vs CG. Average corrosion depths: CG 11.01 μm, 3-passes-DG 2.71 μm, 7-passes-NG 1.86 μm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ra and Rz values of the 3-passes-DG sample were 92% and 89% lower than that of the CG sample, respectively. ... the average corrosion depths of the CG, 3-passes-DG, ... and 7-passes-NG samples were 11.01 μm, 2.71 μm, ... and 1.86 μm.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows CG sample uniform grains nearly dislocation-free with spherical G.P. zones and strip-like precipitates; 3-passes has dislocation structures/walls/tangles; 7-passes has equiaxed nanocrystals average size ~57 nm with continuous SAED rings.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The grains of this sample are uniform and almost free of dislocations ... A large number of dislocation structures were generated in the grains after 3 USRP passes ... the surface grains of the 7-passes USRP sample are refined into equiaxed nanocrystals ... average grain size of these nanocrystals was ~57 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: Surface compressive residual stress: CG very low; 3-passes-DG 736 MPa (layer depth 560 μm); 7-passes-NG 775 MPa (layer depth 620 μm).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The surface compressive residual stress of the 3-passes-DG sample reached 736 MPa, and the layer depth of this sample reached 560 μm. The surface compressive residual stress of the 7-passes-NG sample was 39 MPa higher than that of the 3-passes-DG sample.

nodes.characterization_summary: All samples show passivation; USRP samples have left-shifted passivation zones and lower current densities. 7-passes-NG: Ecorr -1.088 V_SCE, Icorr 5.445×10^{-6} A/cm², CR 0.171 mm/year.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ecorr values of all the USRP-treated samples were more positive than that of the CG sample. ... 7-passes-NG: -1.088, 5.445 × 10-6, 0.171.

nodes.characterization_summary: Nyquist plots show larger capacitive semicircles for USRP samples, largest for 7-passes-NG. Rct values: CG 2093 Ω·cm², 3-passes-DG 2987 Ω·cm², 7-passes-NG 5206 Ω·cm².
nodes.evidence_snippet: The radii of the capacitive semicircles of the USRP-treated samples were larger than that of the CG sample. The largest capacitive semicircle radius was obtained by the 7-passes-NG sample. ... Rct values of the CG, ... 7-passes-NG samples were 2093, ... and 5206 Ω·cm².
